system.description:
Whether through illness or design incompatibility, people of this culture are incapable of standard or simple reproduction and instead claim or reclaim other entities to bring into their culture. While this is particularly common among machine cultures who adopt organics or other machines into their collective, there are those who collect the dead of other cultures to modify their bodies and reactivate them. For some cultures this means necromantic and transformative rituals, for others it means nanites or cybernetic implants. Still others upload the dead into neural networks of android bodies. Of course, you may simply be an organic life form adopted by androids or other irreproducing entities who sought a family of their own.

While you weren’t born into this culture in a traditional manner, these people are as much family as any other might be. Maybe moreso, for good or ill, depending on your reaction to being adopted or kidnapped into the collective.

Characters raised in the Irreproducing culture share a variety of traits in common with one another.

Adoption

Choose an animal or nonsapient drone to be your adopted pet. You gain advantage on any Animal Handling, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Science skill used in relation to your adopted pet. You may only have one adopted pet at a time but may select a new adopted pet at the end of a long rest in a safe haven.

Beyond Blood

The bonds that you experienced as you grew up in this culture have given you a strong perspective on Found Family. At the end of a long rest in a safe haven, choose a number of creatures up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). When you attempt to Help these creatures or use a spell or ability that heals or repairs them as an action, you may instead spend a bonus action to do so. You may use this benefit a number of times per short rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Finding Family

While your family found you, for good or ill, you’ve also learned to find others with the same methods. Whenever you make a skill check to locate a specific creature, alive or dead, you gain an expertise die.

Recovery Operations

Choose between the following options based on how your culture claims new members:

Arcanocollection

Using necromantic rituals, your culture reclaims the dead or brings the lost into the collective. You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill.

Technological Restoration

Whether your culture uses technology to reanimate dead tissue or simply is machine-based, you gain the Engineering or Use Computer skill.
